title: C2 拽拉+赖床 床侧中景长镜拆段 (I2VA 16:9 中文对白直出配音+烧字幕)
prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, warm golden morning light, cozy bedroom, horizontal 16:9, the scene begins exactly as shown in <Picture 1>: a 90-degree bedside medium shot of the same East Asian Chinese man about 28, oval face, soft short side-parted black hair, clean-shaven, wearing a DEEP NAVY crew-neck short-sleeve tee and matching deep navy home pants, leaning over the bed with both hands gripping the wrists of the same East Asian Chinese woman about 26 with messy tousled bed hair in a loose off-white sleep dress, who is still half-lying in the curled position carried over from the previous shot with the quilt flung aside; the side window casts warm high-saturation golden light and the identities, clothing, colors, and bed layout stay consistent with the frame. The camera holds a static bedside shot from the 90-degree side. From 0.00 to 00:02.500, the man pulls firmly upward on her wrists so her upper body is dragged off the pillow and her hair swings, going from half-lying to hauled up toward sitting with the wrist skin visibly taut; the man (S1), in a mid-range male voice, says with natural lip-sync: <d>[Chinese] 数三下啊,一——二——</d>. From 00:02.500 to 00:05.000, her arms go limp and she flops all the way back into the pillow, buries her face, and pulls the quilt up over her head, going from hauled-up to collapsed back and burrowed under the covers while the man's hands hover helplessly in the air; the woman (S2), muffled, says with natural lip-sync: <d>[Chinese] 再睡五分钟……</d> followed by a soft giggle. From 00:05.000 to 00:06.000, an anchor tail holds on her buried under the quilt with a faint shoulder shrug before the clip ends.

overall_soundscape: A warm quiet morning room tone with the creak of the mattress, the friction of dragged fabric and bedding, the soft thud of her flopping back into the pillow, and her light muffled giggle.
